description: HTTP status, response headers, redirect chain, timing and a security-header audit. Requests a URL (HEAD or GET) and returns the final status, every redirect hop, response headers, latency and an audit of security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, COOP/CORP) with a grade, plus cookie flags (Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite) without cookie values. Price: $0.005 USDC per call via x402 (eip155:8453).
